## Nanotrasen Personnel Standard Operating Procedure
# Part one: Succesion In the event of an extreme emergency, NT Personnel roles may take up the banner of acting Captain or HoS. Blueshield Officer and the Nanotrasen Representative are both eligible. Any other role taking acting should only be done in the event of a dire emergency. Requesting ERT support by secure terminal or fax is highly advised before events escalate this far.
# Part two: Blueshield Officer expectations The Blueshield Officer is a bodyguard employed by Nanotrasen to protect other Nanotrasen Personnel primarily, and additionally ensure the wellbeing of Command. Importance is prioritized by rank, in command's order of succession. Unless there is NO SECURITY, the Blueshield Officer should NOT engage in arrests that do not deal directly with attacks on, or from, NTP and Station Command.
# Part three: NT Career Trainer Our lovely mentors may take the NT Career Trainer role at their discretion. You should make yourself known and offer assistance to the crew (excluding command, besides general questions only related to Command itself) where possible. Prioritize helping as many as you reasonably can, but don't overwork yourself. We're happy to have you here.
